newsitem.title: USA: Hi-Lo 13.4 pct holder to seek board seats.
newsitem.headline: Hi-Lo 13.4 pct holder to seek board seats.

text.p: A group including Hwang Family Ltd Partnership said Monday it will solicit proxies for three seats on Hi-Lo Automotive Inc's board of directors.

In a filing with the U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission, the 13.4 percent shareholder group said shares in the Houston-based auto parts retailer are "grossly underpriced as a result of mismanagement."

The group said it believes shareholder values can be enhanced by replacing the present board of directors with three candidates nominated by the group, which would include Micahel Ward, Fred Hwang and Kwang-chou Hwang.

"The group intends to solicit proxies from shareholders for the upcoming annual meeting," the group said. "If the effort is successful, the group should be able to control the board and will look for a buyer for the company and concurrently will implement various measures to improve the operations of Hi-Lo Automotive."
In February, the group proposed that a special panel be formed to search for a potential buyer.
The company in January reported a net loss in 1996 of $53.7 million on sales of $248.6 million.
